user.title: Connect to Moj Elektro
user.description: Create an API token in the Moj Elektro portal (profile, API services). The integration sends it in the X-API-TOKEN header.

data_description.token: The token is shown once when you create it. It is stored only in Home Assistant.

select_meter.title: Metering point
select_meter.description: These identifiers come from GET /souporaba. The API has no list of every metering point, so you can also enter one manually.

meter.title: Metering point
meter.description: Enter the enotni identifikator merilnega mesta (for example 3-123456) or a GSRN. The EIMM is on the metering point in the Moj Elektro portal.

data_description.usage_point: This is the usagePoint parameter. An EIMM looks like 3-123456.

reauth_confirm.title: Update API token
reauth_confirm.description: The token for metering point {usage_point} was rejected. Create a new one and paste it here.

error.invalid_auth: The API token was rejected (HTTP 401 or 403).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Moj Elektro API.
error.invalid_usage_point: This metering point was not found, or the token cannot access it.
error.unknown: Unexpected error from the Moj Elektro API.

abort.already_configured: This metering point is already configured.
abort.unknown: The config entry no longer exists.
